summary: Keep. Operator: 29 full-service drive-through sites, 30 A ($39/night + PST; $1,100/month, $2,900 season), limited 50 A by phone; online booking engine live. Price gate passes (C$39). Nightly share not measurable from the operator's pages. Not waterfront kept, pin fine. Phone empty -> 1-306-238-4653.
flags: LONG-STAY: nightly share NOT measured - the operator posts a nightly rate ($39), monthly ($1,100) and seasonal ($2,900) rates for the same 29 sites but no split; the booking engine (bookonthenet, reCAPTCHA) was not searched. No wording discouraging nightly guests ('Book a cottage for a night or two, reserve an RV site for a family vacation, or look into flexible passes and longer stays'). Google Maps 4.7 from 147 reviews, but that place is the golf club (shared with the course and restaurant), not the RV park alone.
PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest electric night C$39 (30 A) plus PST/GST, operator packages page.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. The RV strip (54.3870-54.3895, -109.3524) sits east of the course road, ~250 m+ north of the lakeshore across fields and the clubhouse area (Esri z16).
PIN: no move; stored 54.38850,-109.35240 is inside the RV strip. Google's place (54.38780,-109.35534) is the clubhouse ~200 m WSW.
PHONE: empty -> 1-306-238-4653 (operator contact page 'Proshop ... Phone: 1-306-238-4653'; Google the same).
